mapper.select: select id, action_name as actionName, biz_key as bizKey, status, current_step_index as currentStepIndex, total_step_count as totalStepCount, attributes_json as attributesJson, last_error_code as lastErrorCode, last_error_message as lastErrorMessage, version, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from action_instance where id = #{id}

select id, action_name as actionName, biz_key as bizKey, status, current_step_index as currentStepIndex, total_step_count as totalStepCount, attributes_json as attributesJson, last_error_code as lastErrorCode, last_error_message as lastErrorMessage, version, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from action_instance where action_name = #{actionName} and biz_key = #{bizKey} order by created_at desc limit 1
